A wonderful Vietnamese restaurant although costly.
Feb 2025 • Family
Ngou Suong is a fantastically good restaurant. 

We made reservations, which is important for two people, and we were seated promptly upon arrival.

Every dish that we ordered was excellent. This included steamed clams, morning, glory, shrimp cocktail, fried shrimp, and crab. 

We both also had the lychee mojito which was very refreshing.

Our waiter was outstanding and he kept on replacing our used plates with clean plates.

The restaurant is attractive and the clientele looked first rate. 

For Ho Chi Minh City this restaurant is expensive, but for a special occasion is well worth the cost

reviews.review_text:
Nhi Bui
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam6 contributions
0
The restaurant has the best crab hotpot in Saigon
Jan 2024 • Business
I've heard a lot about the reputation of Ngoc Suong restaurant, but only now have I had the opportunity to dine here. Really impressive. I ordered seafood spring rolls, fish salad, ikura cheese baked scallops, steamed grouper, beef marrow, crab hotpot, oysters,... all dishes were fresh and prepared with delicious spices. My friend commented that this restaurant's crab hotpot is the best in Saigon, the lump of crab is huge. Personally, I'm impressed with the steamed grouper fish dish because the fish is extremely fresh and delicious, the steamed water is delicious. Sip it clean without leaving any drops. If you have a chance to visit, I recommend ordering these two dishes. That day, I went with 9 people and the bill was less than 9 million. Because each person was less than 1 million, we had a perfect experience of eating and drinking freely. The staff here are cute and enthusiastic. The VIP room is quite private. When checking in, the room was a bit hot even though the air conditioner was turned on. Later, the staff helped adjust it so points were not deducted for this section. My friends sat down to eat and drink beer until 1 o'clock but the restaurant still welcomed us. Because we had a pretty satisfying experience here, we wanted to share it here so everyone can know about another okie space seafood restaurant in District 1 Saigon.

The place is beautifully designed
May 2020 • Friends
The place is beautifully designed and has a fresh & welcoming esthetic. I love the color play here as it is a different and more modern take from its predecessor branch that’s near Observatory. Ngoc Suong is already a familiar brand synonymous with taste and food quality so expect nothing less here. Super modern take on the same fresh seafood they always use.

Been here twice. Both were great experiences.
Once for lunch: highlight is the Conch Caviar
Once for brunch: highlight was the eggs Benedict 

Definitely one of the top new dining/brunch spots this year.
